title: fix: prevent chat stalls during progress-card saves
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes chat and other database writes becoming stuck when a progress-card save overlaps a history search.

## User Impact

Messages and progress-card updates can finish during concurrent history reads. No configuration, schema, stored-data, or migration changes are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Writer-held session target discovery now uses a separate read-only worker lane, so its awaited cleanup cannot join a history task waiting for that same writer. The lane uses the existing lifecycle owner and starts on demand; the tradeoff is one additional lazy reader worker. FIFO ordering, current-target authorization, reader custody, and write settlement remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- A real progress-card/history regression timed out at the existing 120-second deadline before the fix and completed in about 1.04 seconds afterward.
- All 153 focused tests passed, including write ordering, authority rollback, aliases and physical identity, lifecycle cleanup, cancellation, forks, incognito state, and uncertain-commit handling.
- Core production types and all 27 core-test type graphs passed.
- `pnpm test src/gateway/progress-card-store.worker.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 25.05 seconds wall time after the patch (7 tests, 6.47 seconds test time, including the 1.04-second regression). The failing-before command took 143.41 seconds including cold compilation. Hosted CI timing is not yet available.
- Formatting, targeted lint, diff checks, and remaining changed-scope guards passed.
- The full changed-check run stopped at an unused `ClientVoiceToolEffect` export in untouched `src/talk/client-voice-session-store.ts`. Its source matches the base exactly; no clean-baseline full scan was run, so this is unchanged-source attribution, not a claimed baseline reproduction.

- Independent scoped review completed with no P0/P1 findings.

### CI follow-up

The initial hosted changed-test job caught a stale interception in `conversation-list.test.ts`: its source-replacement case still waited for target discovery on the history lane. The same failure reproduced locally (1 failed, 9 passed). The fixture now intercepts the lane appropriate to each read phase, retaining real worker execution, file replacement, awaited cleanup, and the source-change rejection. All 10 conversation-list tests pass after this correction (`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/conversation-list.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 9.10 seconds wall time). No production change was needed. The initial failed CI remains failed; this is a repaired fixture, not a rerun-only claim.

Independent P0/P1 review of the test correction passed. A separate read-only sibling audit found no further stale discovery interceptions.

The correction also passes its Gateway test type graph, targeted lint, formatting, and changed-scope guards. The broader dead-export scan still stops on the same untouched voice export disclosed above.
